videos.description: Photorealistic premium logistics commercial. A Dutch female import coordinator seated on the left at her desk in a sunlit modern harbour office, Rotterdam cranes blurred outside. A single large open laptop is the central subject, screen facing camera almost straight on, all four rectangular display corners fully visible and unobstructed throughout. The entire display is perfectly flat uniform saturated magenta #ff00ff, no text no graphics no reflections, thick dark bezel, screen occupies 60 percent of frame width. Hands rest on desk away from display. Very slow smooth camera dolly toward laptop over eight seconds; subtle human breathing. Realistic materials, restrained blue navy palette warm natural light. No cuts. No other screens. Landscape 1920x1080.
